sprint.description: The sprint to build: its number in ephemeral/research/api/SPRINTS.md, e.g. 3.

issues.description: GitHub issues to work beside the sprint, each in a worktree and branch of its own, e.g. [120].

repo.description: Absolute path of the repository. The sprint's laps are committed to the branch checked out there, and the sprint ends by merging that branch.

model.description: Codex model for the researchers, the planners, and the coders, e.g. "gpt-5.6-luna".

review_model.description: Claude Code model for the supervisors and the validators, e.g. "haiku".

laps.description: The most laps one piece of work may run. It fails if its planner is not done by then.
